versions.changelog:
- Default behavior changed: qshare now uploads files to CNB (3-day retention, manual deletion) instead of serving via TryCloudflare tunnel.
- TryCloudflare tunnel serving is now only used with the explicit --cf flag.
- CNB uploads start immediately without a pre-upload confirmation; deletion prompt appears post-upload.
- Clarified instructions on sharing, retention, and deletion for both CNB and --cf channels.
- Added distinction between channel options, retention periods, and operational prompts.

- Initial release of qshare skill.
- Share a local file by generating a temporary, public TryCloudflare URL with qshare.
- Optionally upload files to the qshare CNB release with explicit user confirmation.
- Includes user safety guidance on access control and file sensitivity.
- Follows operational best practices for foreground/background operation and error handling.
